terraformNaming: Convert service-specific camelCase input names to snake_case.
terraformRoot: Each platform-apps/<service>/terraform directory is a runnable root with an empty azurerm backend block, exact provider versions and committed lock file.
examples: examples/platform/<service>/<engine>/README.md plus .bicepparam for Bicep and .example.tfvars.json for Terraform. Bicep examples import the local wrapper; Terraform docs run the catalog's fixed root, not a mutable module download.
vmImage: The exact image in catalog/platform.json was verified through read-only Azure discovery and is hardcoded in both implementations. Recheck regional availability before any connected rehearsal.
tags: Platform-owned metadata only. Hardcode required security settings in the wrapper; do not expose raw AVM configuration objects.
runtime: Linux Web App using the supported NODE|24-lts platform-managed runtime and Entra zip deployment; patch lifecycle is Azure-managed and explicitly documented. Container App uses catalog/platform.json's exact digest and port.
applicationPayload: A dependency-free Node HTTP hello-world for Web App. Do not run consumer source on the privileged infrastructure runner; payload deployment is a separately documented trusted-release operation.
validation: No live deployments. scripts/tooling.mjs installs checksum-pinned binaries locally. Run npm run iac:check; Container Apps mock coverage is explicitly unavailable because of the upstream ephemeral resource schema.
